hyperCommons.heading: The Hyperobjects Commons
hyperCommons.subtitle: A cartridge doesn’t define one object — it defines every object inside its parameter range. We call these Bounded 4D Hyperobjects: open designs that share standard interfaces, so the Commons grows as one system.
hyperCommons.whatIsBody: Traditional 3D files are static — one geometry, frozen at one size. A hyperobject is the computational definition of a whole family of objects, bounded by the rules of its code and its manifest. Change the parameters and you get another member of the family.
hyperCommons.whyBody: A hyperobject is never the thing on your desk — it is everything the thing can become. Every object here is a family: one contract; infinite sizes, materials, and configurations. The word is borrowed twice: from philosophy — Timothy Morton’s vast, unpointable giants, scaled here to the workbench — and from hypertext, the object that generates objects. Yours to regenerate, forever.
hyperCommons.shiftFromDesc: One fixed geometry. One size. Download and hope it fits.
hyperCommons.shiftToDesc: A family of geometries. Your dimensions. One exact instance to print.
hyperCommons.domainsSubtitle: From your desk drawer to the factory floor — each domain built on standard interfaces communities already use.

hyperCommons.fourDBody: Every cartridge is 3D geometry plus one more axis: its parameters, and, played back, time. Each point along that axis is one exact, printable 3D solid. Yantra4D projects the family down to the instance you choose — the one you see in the viewer, the one you export, the one you print.
hyperCommons.fourDSweeps: Some cartridges also declare sweeps: a path from one parameter state to another over time, sampled into frames, so the family can be played changing shape (playback in Studio is a Pro feature) — an arm extending its reach, a gear growing its teeth.

cdg.heading: The Interfaces That Connect Everything
cdg.subtitle: CDG is the standardized geometry that lets the Commons interoperate. Each CDG names one real interface — a thread, a rail, a grid, a bolt pattern — and the cartridges that declare it can be built to mate.
cdg.explainerBody: CDG is the geometric ground truth that lets a filter fit a standard bottle, a clip snap onto a standard rail, and a bin sit on a standard grid. Standardize the interface, and the community builds the rest.

cdg.impactBody: Stop designing products. Start designing interfaces. A perfect Gridfinity base is more valuable than 1,000 different cup holders.

hyperobjects.title: Hyperobjects
hyperobjects.description: Software-defined physical objects that exist across multiple dimensions of customization.
hyperobjects.section1Body1: An STL file is a dead snapshot. A Hyperobject is alive. It is a parametric definition that contains every possible variation of itself.
hyperobjects.section1Body2: When you interact with a Yantra4D project, you aren't downloading a file; you are exploring a Hyperobject's possibility space to find the specific instance that fits your reality.
hyperobjects.parametricDesc: Adjust dimensions and features; constraints keep the combination valid.
hyperobjects.codeDrivenDesc: Written in CadQuery or OpenSCAD, version-controlled with Git, shareable like open-source software.
hyperobjects.manufacturingDesc: Exports the exact instance as STL, 3MF, STEP and more, ready for your slicer or CAD.

cdg.title: Common Denominator Geometry
cdg.description: A universal language for 3D design that ensures compatibility and remixability across the entire ecosystem.
cdg.heroSubtitle: The universal DNA of every object in the Yantra4D ecosystem.
cdg.section1Body: CDG names the real-world standards a part must meet — a Gridfinity grid, a DIN rail, a bottle thread — so cartridges that declare the same interface can be built to fit together.
cdg.remixBody: Because interfaces are standardized, a part built to one standard can meet a part built to the same standard by someone else. Fork a cartridge, keep its interface, change the rest.

commons.title: The Commons
commons.description: A shared, open library of parametric wisdom owned by everyone.
commons.heroSubtitle: Open, parametric hardware, shared under one licence and built on shared standards.
commons.section1Body: The Yantra4D Commons is not a walled garden. It is a public library of designs. When you contribute a Hyperobject, you aren't giving it to a corporation—you are gifting it to the global community of makers.
commons.forkDesc: Derivative works are encouraged, not restricted.
commons.copyleftDesc: Designs carry CERN-OHL-W, the weakly reciprocal CERN hardware licence: changes to a design stay open, and the design can still go into a product next to parts under other licences. The platform itself is AGPLv3.
commons.globalDesc: Built on real metric and imperial standards, cited in the manifests.
commons.joinBody: Start your journey by exploring the existing Commons or configuring your first Hyperobject.
